claim: This finding from the previous review no longer holds at the reviewed head: 2. A blank value quietly turns off a setting the configuration file explicitly enabled. The `mode="before"` validator at `src/sqllens/config.py` lines 220 to 229 coerces any whitespace-only string to `False` with no diagnostic, and because the environment wins over the TOML file, an accidentally empty `SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_TEXT_MEMORIES` overrides `save_text_memories = true`. The acceptance criteria do require the blank value to load rather than fail, so the outcome is as specified, but the project's rule that failures must surface as structured signal argues for a warning on the overriding-blank path. Note also that a blank `SQLLENS_MEMORY__SAVE_QUERIES` still fails validation, so two adjacent booleans in the same model answer the same malformed input differently. (raised by 1/5 agents)
